_comment: Copy to ~/.persona-panel/config.json (user) or ./.persona-panel.json (project), or create one with: python skills/persona-panel/scripts/config.py init. Every key is optional and keys you leave out use the built-in defaults (shown here), so it is best to keep only the keys you change. Keys starting with '_' are ignored. Precedence: defaults < user config < project config < command-line flags.
_runs_dir: runs_dir (left out on purpose): by default runs go to <home>/runs, where <home> is $PERSONA_PANEL_HOME or ~/.persona-panel. To move them, add "runs_dir": "~/persona-panel-runs" (relative paths resolve against this file's folder).
